facts.text: Penn State York features the Graham Center for Innovation and Collaboration, which houses both the Graham Fellows Program for Entrepreneurial Leadership and the Center for Inclusive Leadership.

sources.title: Graham Fellows Program for Entrepreneurial Leadership at Penn State York | Penn State York
sources.quote: The Graham Center for Innovation and Collaboration (The Graham Center) is the newest building on campus and is home to the Graham Fellows Program for Entrepreneurial Leadership (Graham Fellows Program) and the Center for Inclusive Leadership (CIL).

facts.text: Penn State York features The Pullo Center, a 1,016-seat theatre that presents touring Broadway shows, concerts, and educational events.

sources.title: About | Pullo Center
sources.quote: The Pullo Center at Penn State York features a 1,016-seat theatre with full production capabilities. The Pullo Center offers a diverse array of touring shows, concerts, and cultural, community, and educational events.
